text:
alex: Noticed PII showing up from the TypeScript sampleapp when DEBUG logging is enabled on Windows containers. Seems like redactor is skipped when otel-node attaches a context-bound logger.

sam: Windows-specific? or happens on linux too?

alex: Reprobed on both but the failure mode is much noisier on Windows (we have different stdout driver). Repro steps: `node dist/server.js` in docker-for-windows, then run /scripts/repro-windows.sh with concurrency 25.

maria: paste a leak snippet? and the bootstrap order (init files)

alex: snippet:```
2026-06-10T08:12:12.345Z INFO reqid=ts-42 route=/generate payload={"email":"dana@ex.com","text":"ok"}
2026-06-10T08:12:12.349Z ERROR reqid=ts-42 stack="Error: boom"
2026-06-10T08:12:12.350Z DEBUG reqid=ts-42 redactor=skipped payload={"phone":"+12125551212"}
```

alex: bootstrap:```ts
import './otel-init'
import './reqid'
import './logger'
import './redactor'
```

lee: otel-init probably wraps console or provides a context logger that bypasses our pipeline. Historically moving redactor before otel-init or ensuring the logger encoder runs redaction fixes it.

sam: agree. Two immediate fixes: 1) in reqid attach context via als.run to pin reqid, 2) ensure logger encoder applies redaction in the final stringify path.

maria: PR #3000 switches the load order to init redactor before otel and updates the TS logger to run a final redact step in stringify. Also added a defensive check in redactor: if (!reqid) emit `redactor_bypass` metric and tag line as volatile.

alex: good. QA note: in Windows the default JSON formatter we ship writes CRLF and some of our grep CI checks missed it. I updated the grep to handle CRLF and the new sampleapp windows job in CI.

sam: please add an integration that simulates otel attaching a context-bound logger (call to Logger.withFields) so we catch this in unit tests. Also add a linter rule to forbid libs using asyncLocalStorage.enterWith directly.

maria: added integ `tests/integ/otel-bypass.test.ts` and a linter rule in eslint config that flags `asyncLocalStorage.enterWith` usage outside our wrapper. Also added `/scripts/repro-windows.sh`.

ops-bot: deploy sampleapp/ts/staging v3.2.1 -> success :white_check_mark: (build 10221)

lee: temporary mitigation: set LOG_LEVEL=info for Dedicated and staging Windows clusters until the patch is live: `kubectl set env deploy/sampleapp LOG_LEVEL=info -n dedicated-windows`

alex: PR landed. I'll run the repro and then request backport to 3.1.x.

sam: will review the linter and integ tests. Great catch, alex. :thumbsup:
